definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.150) procedure: 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division'; 2023 adds 'paragraph, section' and 'that include the executable code'. Procedure-names are paragraph or section names in both (SR11/SR12), so the governed ranges are the same.

pending-clause.answer: Triggered by 'declarative'. SR9 is a compile-time constraint on where a PERFORM range's procedure-names lie; it does not rest on how exception conditions are processed (§2002:14.5.12.1.2/1.3) or on incompatible data (§2002:14.5.12.2). All three cases are shown at --std 2002 (pb433 and the two COBOL2186 probes).

band-formats.answer: 2002 SR9 names procedure-name-1 and procedure-name-2, which exist only in the out-of-line format (§2002:14.8.27.1 Format 1), the 2023 format 1 that SR-14.9.28.3-11 is banded to. Same reach.
